
## tumor

```{r}
sub <- sce[, which(sce$lv2 == "tum")]
mtx <- counts(sub)[c("CCND1", "SOX11"), ] > 0
c(rowMeans(mtx), both=mean(colAlls(mtx)))
```

## signatures

```{r sig}
sig <- altExp(sce, "UCell")
# order contexts by tumor fraction
xo_ctx <- scale_x_discrete(limits=levels(sce$cty))
xo_bin <- scale_x_discrete(limits=levels(sce$bin))
# order cores by proliferation proxy
mv <- by(assay(sig)["S-Phase", idx <- which(sig$lv2 == "tum")], sig$sid[idx], mean)
xo_sid <- scale_x_discrete(limits=names(mv)[order(mv)])
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
.plt_cor <- \(se) {
    pal <- rev(pals::brewer.puor(99))
    pheatmap::pheatmap(cor(t(assay(se))),
        main="inter-signature correlation",
        cellwidth=10, cellheight=10,
        treeheight_row=20, treeheight_col=20, 
        fontsize=9, color=pal, border_color=NA)
}
.plt_avg <- \(se, by) {
    df <- data.frame(t(assay(se)), colData(se), check.names=FALSE)
    fd <- pivot_longer(df, all_of(rownames(se)))
    mu <- fd |>
        filter(!is.na(!!sym(by))) |>
        group_by(name, !!sym(by)) |>
        summarise_at("value", mean) |>
        group_by(name) |>
        mutate_at("value", .z)
    mx <- pivot_wider(mu)
    my <- as.matrix(mx[, -1])
    rownames(my) <- mx[[1]]
    ggplot(mu, aes(.data[[by]], name, fill=value)) + geom_tile() +
        scale_fill_gradientn(
            "z-scaled\nmean UCell", 
            colors=rev(pals::brewer.rdgy(99)),
            limits=c(-2.5, 2.5), breaks=seq(-2, 2, 2)) +
        scale_x_discrete(limits=.xo(my)) +
        scale_y_discrete(limits=.yo(my)) +
        coord_equal(expand=FALSE) +
        .thm_fig_c("minimal") + theme(
            axis.title=element_blank(),
            axis.text.x=element_text(angle=90, hjust=1, vjust=0.5))
}
```

```{r sig-nkt}
.sig <- sig[rowData(sig)$typ == "t-atlas", which(sig$lv1 == "nkt")]
```

```{r sig-nkt-hm, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
#| code-fold: true
.plt_avg(.sig, "lv2") + 
.plt_avg(.sig, "cty") + xo_ctx +
.plt_avg(.sig, "sid") + xo_sid +
plot_layout(guides="collect")
```

```{r sig-tum}
.sig <- sig[rowData(sig)$typ != "t-atlas", which(sig$cty %in% "TUM")]
```

```{r sig-tum-hm, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}

.plt_avg(.sig, "sid") + xo_sid +

```

## signaling

```{r ccc}
(x <- altExp(sce, "COMMOT"))
```

```{r plt-hm}
#| code-fold: true
.plt_hm <- \(df, gs, x, xo=TRUE, yo=TRUE, ax=TRUE) {
    # wrangling
    mu <- df |>
        group_by(!!!sym(x)) |>
        summarise(across(all_of(gs), mean))
    # scaling
    fd <- mu |>
        mutate(across(all_of(gs), .z)) |>
        pivot_longer(all_of(gs))
    # ordering
    mx <- pivot_wider(fd)
    my <- as.matrix(mx[, -1])
    rownames(my) <- seq(nrow(my))
    xo <- if (xo) scale_x_discrete(limits=mx[[1]][as.integer(.xo(my))])
    yo <- if (yo) scale_y_discrete(limits=.yo(my))
    # aesthetics
    ax <- if (ax) theme(
        axis.title.x=element_blank(),
        axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, vjust=1, hjust=1)) else
        theme(axis.text.x=element_blank(), axis.ticks.x=element_blank())
    # plotting
    ggplot(fd, aes(.data[[x]], name, fill=value)) +
        scale_fill_gradientn(
            "z-scaled\nmean score",
            colors=rev(pals::brewer.rdgy(9)),
            limits=c(-2.5,2.5), breaks=seq(-2,2,2)) +
        labs(y=NULL) + coord_equal(2/3, expand=FALSE) + 
        geom_tile() + xo + yo + .thm_fig_c("bw") + ax
}
```

### pws

```{r pws}
gs <- rownames(y <- x[rowData(x)$type == "Pathway", ])
mx <- t(as.matrix(Reduce(`+`, assays(y))/2))
df <- data.frame(colData(sce), mx, check.names=FALSE)
```

```{r pws-ctx, fig.width=15, fig.height=4}
#| code-fold: true
mu <- by(mx, df$cty, colMeans)
mv <- as.matrix(array2DF(mu)[, -1])
rownames(mv) <- names(mu)
ps <- lapply(xs <- rownames(mv), \(i) {
    j <- setdiff(xs, i)
    b <- colMeans(mv[j, ])
    gs <- names(tail(sort(mv[i, ]/b), 30))
    .plt_hm(df, gs, "cty", xo=FALSE, ax=TRUE) + ggtitle(i)
})
wrap_plots(ps, nrow=1, guides="collect")
```

### lrs

```{r lrs}
gs <- rownames(y <- x[!rowData(x)$type %in% c("Total", "Pathway"), ])
mx <- t(as.matrix(Reduce(`+`, assays(y))/2))
df <- data.frame(colData(sce), mx, check.names=FALSE)
```

```{r lrs-ctx, fig.width=15, fig.height=8}
#| code-fold: true
mu <- by(mx, df$cty, colMeans)
mv <- as.matrix(array2DF(mu)[, -1])
rownames(mv) <- names(mu)
ps <- lapply(xs <- rownames(mv), \(i) {
    j <- setdiff(xs, i)
    b <- colMeans(mv[j, ])
    gs <- names(tail(sort(mv[i, ]/b), 30))
    .plt_hm(df, gs, "cty", xo=FALSE, ax=TRUE) + ggtitle(i)
})
wrap_plots(ps, nrow=2, guides="collect")
```

```{r message=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=7.5}
ys <- altExp(sce, "UCell")
ys <- assay(ys)["S-Phase", ]
ys <- unname(.z(ys, th=1.5))
ys[which(sce$lv2 != "tum")] <- NA
dy <- range(ys, na.rm=TRUE)
cs <- split(seq(ncol(sce)), sce$sid)
names(id) <- id <- names(cs)
ps <- lapply(id, \(.) {
    se <- sce[, cs[[.]]]
    ys <- ys[cs[[.]]]
    o <- order(abs(ys), na.last=FALSE)
    .plt_xy(se[, o], ys[o], s=0.2, id=., na=TRUE)
})
wrap_plots(ps[xo_sid$limits], 
    nrow=3, guides="collect") &
    #theme(legend.position="none") &
    scale_color_gradientn(
        na.value="lightgrey", limits=dy,
        colors=c("cyan", "navy", "magenta"))
```
